relationship_to_exp192: Adds a third fixed policy evaluation using outputs already required by EXP190/191 confirmation; it does not change the two original policies, models, parameters, cohort, chunks, or GPU work.

frozen_policy.forward_6bba_target: Always base min8, identical to EXP190 and EXP191.
frozen_policy.reverse_operator: choose g45_t20+min6 when feature <= 0.08388494131521039; otherwise choose base min3
frozen_policy.threshold_source: Linear q75 over all 12 previously opened reverse-development movies.

primary_evaluation: Apply once to all 175 untouched EXP192 movies after all chunks pass the no-metric gate; score pooled official sufficient statistics.
promotion_gate_vs_exp190: Forward must reproduce exactly; reverse and pooled delta must be positive; direction-stratified paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound must be >0. Report movie selection counts and all standard diagnostics.
anti_adaptation: The threshold and rule are frozen now. No target feature distribution, intermediate target graph, target score, or per-movie metric may change them.
